stem: Suppose the farmer wants to make a much larger orchard with many rows of trees. As the farmer makes the orchard bigger, which will increase more quickly: the number of apple trees or the number of conifers? Explain how you found your answer.
correctAnswer: Apple trees (n²) increase more quickly than conifers (8n) for large n, because n² is quadratic while 8n is linear — for large n, n² grows much faster.
steps: For large n, n² grows quadratically, 8n grows linearly
Therefore apple trees increase more quickly
